title: The Power of (Random?) Connections
content: When Ashley Lynch kindly invited me to write a Field and Bench article, my immediate inclination was to politely decline. Having just finished writing a 200,000-word book on the biology and management of non-native species (Alyokhin 2026), I was struggling with writing burnout. Following a typical push-pull scenario, which is commonly advocated but seldom practiced in integrated pest management, the computer keyboard became a powerful repellent. Both field and bench, on the other hand, called on me to come back to real life, rather than to write about them in the confines of my office.
